stories.title: Woman running sex racket arrested in Kanpur:Etawah Police nabs her from Kalyanpur; accused of blackmailing too
stories.summary: Police from Etawah's Civil Lines station conducted a raid and arrested a woman accused of running a prostitution racket in Kanpur's Kalyanpur police station area on Wednesday. The accused woman has been identified as Rubina alias Ruby. Etawah police took her along with them. According to police, a government department employee has filed a report against the accused woman at Civil Lines station. In the case, serious allegations of alleged blackmail and harassment of a married woman have been made. According to police, the complainant is originally a resident of Jagatpuri, located on Purana Shivli Road in Kalyanpur police station area, and is currently working in the Rural Development Department while living in Etawah. He got married in January 2023. The complainant alleges that his wife was previously in contact with people associated with an event agency. There, Rubina alias Ruby, Shabina alias Dabba, Abhishek Yadav alias Raja and his associate Ritesh used to work. It is alleged that all four used to do bridal makeup work in the event company. Sent video clip to mobile According to police, the deceased had also sent a video clip to her husband's mobile before committing suicide. It is alleged that in the video she had mentioned taking the suicidal step, being troubled by the alleged harassment. Based on the video and complaint, police have started investigating the case. Allegation of flesh trade under the guise of event agency According to Etawah police, during the investigation, allegations have surfaced against Rubina alias Ruby and Shabina alias Dabba of running a flesh trade under the guise of an event agency. Police allege that both women were pressuring the deceased to involve her in the flesh trade. For this, she is accused of being blackmailed by threats to reveal matters from before her marriage to her in-laws. In this case, Etawah Civil Lines police station conducted a raid in Kalyanpur on Wednesday and arrested Rubina alias Ruby. Police have taken her to Etawah. Now police are investigating the role of other people named in the case along with interrogating the accused. Police investigating network Police say that the investigation is also looking into how far the alleged flesh trade network had spread and who all are involved in it. Allegations of blackmailing the deceased and forcing her to commit suicide are also being investigated. Police are interrogating the accused woman to gather information about other accused persons.

stories.title: Akhilesh says, ‘Film City shooting has begun in UP’:Shares video of Etawah encounter; asks, ‘Does the state even have a home minister?’
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav shared a video of the Etawah police encounter on his X account on Wednesday. Taking a jibe at the BJP government and police, he wrote - Film city shooting is ongoing in UP. The people writing the story and script are also from the police. The director and costume designer are also police personnel. Akhilesh claimed that the video is of an encounter with the accused in the mother-daughter murder case in Etawah. In the video, Station In-charge Vikram Singh can be seen bandaging the leg of accused Mukesh Yadav, taking out cartridges from his pocket, and counting ₹2 lakh 31 thousand recovered from the scooter. In Chandethi village of Etawah, the bodies of a mother and daughter were found in their house on the morning of 17 August. Police arrested one accused after an encounter in this case. According to police, while fleeing, the accused fired at the police team. In retaliatory action, police fired back, and one bullet hit his leg. See 3 pictures of the encounter... Read what Akhilesh Yadav wrote in his tweet... Film city shooting is ongoing in UP. The script-screenplay writers are also police people, directors, and costume designers as well. The police caught a criminal in an encounter, and the inspector immediately bandaged him on the spot and completed the entire interrogation right there in Etawah district of UP. Perhaps they will prepare the chargesheet by the time they reach the police station. The capture of the criminal is commendable, but the police's act of staging a drama to show lies as truth is dangerous. Some corrupt policemen are misusing this and making law and order itself a criminal in UP. Is there any Home Minister in UP? Know the complete matter A mother and daughter were murdered by slitting their throats. On the morning of 17 August, around 8 AM, when the milkman reached the house, the door did not open even after knocking for a long time in Chandhethi village of Etawah. When he peeked inside from the back, the body of Pushpa Yadav (55) was found lying in the courtyard, while the body of her daughter Nirmala alias Manju Devi (38) was on a cot in the room. A sickle stained with blood was lying on the cot. Bloodstains were found from the room to the courtyard. After receiving information about the bodies of the mother and daughter, police officers, including SSP Brijesh Kumar Srivastava, immediately inspected the crime scene. Police nabbed the accused in an encounter SOG, surveillance, and Bharthana police station teams were formed to solve the murder case. The teams started interrogating suspects along with scrutinizing CCTV footage. Police received information that the accused Mukesh Yadav was going from Jarpura towards Samhon. Police teams started checking on the route. Meanwhile, a person was seen coming on a red scooter. When police signaled him to stop, he turned the scooter and tried to flee. Bullet hit leg in police encounter According to the police, while fleeing, the accused opened fire at the police team. In retaliatory action, the police fired back, and a bullet hit Mukesh's right leg. He was arrested in an injured condition. 42-year-old Mukesh is a resident of Mainpuri. A video after the encounter also surfaced. In the video, police personnel were seen bandaging the accused's leg. Apart from this, they were also seen taking out cartridges from the accused's pocket and taking out and counting ₹2 lakh 31 thousand from the scooter. According to SSP Brijesh Srivastava- Manju Devi's husband Satyendra had a divorce case pending. On 3 August, the court had ordered him to pay Manju ₹7,000 per month as maintenance. According to the police, angered by this, Satyendra conspired to commit murder along with his friend Mukesh Yadav.

stories.title: Jayant asks, ‘Why does Akhilesh remember me so much?’:Responds to ‘chavanni’ remark; Minister Ashish Patel takes a dig, ‘We don’t play tweet-retweet’
stories.summary: In UP politics, for the last 2 days, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav's 'Chavanni' statement has been much discussed. Akhilesh, without naming RLD chief Jayant Chaudhary, had said - I made a 'chavanni' into a rupee, but he also ran away. Since then, not only Jayant Chaudhary, but also the UP BJP president and NDA allies are targeting Akhilesh. It is believed that after Jayant joined hands with the BJP, a large part of the Jat vote bank in Western UP seems to be in the NDA's favour. That is why Akhilesh's sharp stance could be an attempt to send a message to other backward classes (OBCs) and non-Jat communities to stand with the SP-Congress alliance. First, read what Akhilesh had said On August 17, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, at an event in Lucknow, took a dig at old alliance partners without naming them. He had said - 'We also made some alliances like that, alliance partners came from who knows where. We turned a 'chavanni' into a rupee, yet they left us.' Now read what BJP and its allied leaders said Jayant asked - Why is he remembering me so much? RLD chief Jayant Chaudhary, retaliating against Akhilesh Yadav, said on Wednesday that why he is remembering us so much, this question should be asked to him. It would be good if Akhilesh speaks his mind. But, such statements also force those who stand with him today to think. There is democracy in Uttar Pradesh and the public makes everyone. UP BJP President said - SP is dependent on 'winning faces' UP BJP President Pankaj Chaudhary said - Before the assembly elections, such an earthquake has hit the SP that those who were beating the drums of 'return to power' are now dependent on 'winning faces'. In the seats where SP was dreaming of victory based on appeasement, caste equations, and manipulation, it is becoming difficult to find strong faces with a hold among the public. The condition of the party claiming to return to power is that there are many seats, but there are not enough faces to contest. The secret survey report by the newly appointed Chanakya of SP, a former administrative officer who held a high position in the state, has disturbed the sleep of the entire family. Claims are for 400 seats, but there are ZERO candidates fit to be seated on the 'cycle'. In helplessness, only 2 options are left before the SP chief. Either sideline ordinary workers and field the new scions of the 'family empire'. Or, citing the compulsion of alliance, surrender to Congress's insistence on 200 seats. Ashish Patel said - Apna Dal works among the public Minister Ashish Patel said that SP does not need to worry about how many seats our alliance with BJP will be for? Apna Dal does not play the game of tweets and retweets. The party believes in working among the public and standing strong with its alliance. Ashish Patel's counter-attack is also important because for some time now, Akhilesh Yadav has been continuously taunting BJP's allies regarding their seat-sharing. Rajbhar surrounded - Your 'Indi Alliance' is not working SBSP chief and UP government minister Omprakash Rajbhar also sharply retaliated to Akhilesh Yadav's statement. He said that instead of worrying about others' seats, Akhilesh Yadav should manage his own alliance. Akhilesh travels in a charter plane. If he has ever been on a plane, he must have heard the air hostess's announcement to secure yourself before securing others. The same rule applies to him in politics. His Indi Alliance is not working, and Akhilesh is distributing seats for others. How many seats Suhaaspa will get will be decided through talks with BJP. Akhilesh doesn't need to worry about this. Jayant Chaudhary in the strongest position in NDA Among the NDA's allies, the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) is in the strongest position. RLD's position is strong due to its hold on the Jat vote bank in Western UP. In 2024, after Chaudhary Charan Singh received the 'Bharat Ratna', Jayant joined the NDA and became a minister in the central government. RLD has claimed more than 20 seats in addition to its 9 existing seats, totaling 30+ seats. According to sources, BJP might offer them around 20 seats. Jayant, under a long-term political strategy, does not want to close opposition avenues for the future. Therefore, he avoids directly attacking Akhilesh Yadav or Mayawati.

stories.title: Amazon sold sweets as Ram Mandir prasad:CCPA calls it fraud, imposes ₹1 lakh fine; products removed after notice
stories.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has fined Amazon ₹1 lakh for selling four types of sweets on its e-commerce platform while claiming they were prasad from Ayodhya's Ram Mandir. The fine must be deposited with the authority within 15 days. Amazon removed the listings from its platform after receiving the notice. The CCPA said that selling ordinary sweets as Ram Mandir prasad could hurt the religious sentiments of millions of devotees. Four types of sweets sold as Ram Mandir prasad The products being sold as prasad included ghee laddoos, khoya laddoos, boondi laddoos and pedas made from cow's milk. Their listings described them as prasad from the Ram Mandir. However, Amazon had not obtained permission from the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust to sell the sweets as mandir prasad. According to Bar Bench, CCPA Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare and Commissioner Anupam Mishra took action on August 4, treating the matter as a case of misleading consumers. Amazon has not issued a statement on the matter so far. Now read in detail Religious symbols were used in product listings This matter first came to light in January 2024. Chandu Trading Company had listed 4 types of sweets on Amazon under the brand name 'Bihar Brothers'. These included ghee laddoos, khoya laddoos, boondi laddoos, and pedas made from cow's milk. Religious images were used in the listing of these products. Additionally, it was claimed that these sweets had the 'blessing of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Ayodhya'. In the ingredients column, they were described as 'Ram Mandir Prasad'. Listing happened just before Ram Mandir Pran Pratishtha According to CCPA, these products were listed some time before the Ram Mandir Pran Pratishtha on 22 January, 2024. After receiving a show-cause notice on 19 January in the matter, Amazon had removed these listings. This complaint was filed by the Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT) in January 2024. Amazon described itself as merely a marketplace In its defense, Amazon said that it is only an online marketplace and had no direct role in product listing, price determination, providing details, or sales. The company also cited the 'safe harbor' protection available under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act. CCPA rejected Amazon's arguments. It stated that the Information Technology Act and Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 establish separate legal obligations. No marketplace entity can evade consumer protection responsibilities by citing its intermediary status under the IT Act, while it is earning commercial profits from transactions occurring on its platform. Sales of only ₹39,802 from 4 products Amazon told the CCPA that the four disputed product listings had total sales of ₹39,802. Of this, Amazon received ₹15,165 as service fees. The company also clarified that the previously stated sales of ₹25.26 lakh were not for these four products, but were the total gross merchandise sales of all the seller's listings. The authority issued 2 orders 1- Permission now required for sale in the name of 'Prasad' 2- Seller information must be displayed prominently Swami Rajkumar Das said - Action should be such that it sets an example Swami Rajkumar Das, member of Shri Ram Mandir Religious Committee, strongly objected to this matter. He said, such strict action should be taken against the Amazon company that in the future no company or organization can play with the sentiments of devotees. He said that he is currently out of Ayodhya. After returning to Ayodhya, he will present this matter before the members of the Religious Committee and officials of the Ram Mandir Trust and demand strict action. He said - We are confident that we will take a strict decision in this matter soon.

stories.title: UP Governor Anandiben Patel might be replaced:Went on 10-day leave, ACS says, 'She is visiting Daman and Diu'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel has suddenly gone on leave. She is on leave from 17 August to 26 August. The Governor has gone to her home state, Gujarat. She has taken permission from President Droupadi Murmu for the leave. This is the first time Anandiben Patel has taken such a long leave after becoming the Governor of UP. After this sudden leave, various discussions have started in political and administrative circles. It is being said that UP might soon get a new Governor. However, officially it is being stated that the reason for the Governor's leave is a family and personal event. The Governor's Additional Chief Secretary (ACS) Sudhir Bobde has dismissed speculations of her being relieved of duty or replaced. He says that the Governor is on a visit to Silvassa and Daman and Diu. During this, she has a meeting with the Governor there. Daughter entering election strategy Senior journalist Rajendra Kumar says - Governor Anandiben Patel has gone on leave before this as well. Her entire family lives in Gujarat. Her daughter is entering electoral politics. She herself has been living in UP for a long time. She has set a record by continuously serving as Governor for 7 years. That is why she will remain in this post until someone is appointed in her place. This is why whenever she goes on leave, it becomes a topic of discussion. If she does not return after the leave, it will be considered a political matter. This discussion is gaining more traction because in recent days, she has, in a way, held a mirror to the state government by making comments. This is why such speculations are being made regarding her leave. Governor pressured to extend tenure by taking long leave Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says - The Governor's tenure has ended. It has not been formally extended either. It is obvious that such long leaves lead to speculations. It is also possible that she might be pressuring to extend her tenure. In the country, where governors of some states were to be changed, that has already happened. Anandiben is from Gujarat. She has been close to Prime Minister Modi. She is benefiting from that. Perhaps due to her tenure not being extended, she might be hesitant to continue in her position in an honorable manner. Or perhaps she might have apprehended her removal. This might be the reason she went on leave. Governor's recent statements fueled discussion Anandiben Patel has been the Governor of UP since July 29, 2019. For some time now, the Governor has made strict remarks on everything from universities to government schemes and administrative arrangements. These have increased the government's difficulties. In Gorakhpur, he had criticized the poor hostel facilities and food. At the convocation ceremony of Chandrashekhar Azad University of Agriculture and Technology in Kanpur, he had also adopted a strict stance on negligence. He had spoken about reviewing the arrangements again. At the convocation ceremony of Bundelkhand University on August 14, he had emphasized continuously upgrading universities and programs related to female students. Had avoided air travel The Governor's travels have also been a topic of discussion for some time now. Reports emerged of him traveling by train for some programs. However, this did not happen on every trip. For instance, official information came to light that he arrived by state aircraft to attend the convocation ceremony of Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology in Gorakhpur on August 5. There are also various discussions regarding the Governor's health. It is being said that doctors had advised her to avoid air travel due to health reasons. Now expected to return on 27 August During the Governor's leave, the regular functioning of the Raj Bhavan will continue under the prescribed constitutional arrangement. Anandiben Patel is now expected to resume her regular duties from 27 August. Speculations about change of 6 Governors in the country In fact, there are speculations about the appointment of new governors in 6 states. The governors of UP and Gujarat have been in office for 7 years. Kerala Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar holds additional charge of Tamil Nadu. This responsibility was given to him in March 2026. Anandiben Patel has been in the post of UP Governor since 29 July, 2019. Her tenure has exceeded 7 years. After her is Gujarat Governor Acharya Devvrat, who assumed office on 22 July, 2019. At number three is Madhya Pradesh Governor Mangubhai Patel.

stories.title: Former SP MLC, two brothers among 10 sentenced to life:Lawyer and her teacher sister were shot dead in public
stories.summary: The verdict came six years after the murder of Auraiya-based lawyer Manjul Chaubey and his teacher sister. On Wednesday at 2 pm, the MP-MLA court sentenced 10 convicts, including former SP MLC Kamlesh Pathak and his two brothers, to life imprisonment. On 15 January 2020, Manjul and his sister Sudha were shot dead in broad daylight. Their family members were also chased and beaten. Police personnel who reached the spot after being informed about the incident were attacked as well. Police had registered a case against 19 people in connection with the murders. Of these, 11 were sentenced to seven years each, while seven were acquitted. One accused is a minor and his case is being heard in the juvenile court. Kamlesh and Manjul were once friends. However, they fell out over one bigha of temple land. Kamlesh Pathak allegedly wanted to take possession of the land, while Manjul Chaubey opposed it. This led to a bitter rivalry between the two. How were the brother and sister murdered? Over 900 dates in 6 years, then justice was served In the last 6 years, the case had over 900 dates. Both sides presented 72 witnesses. 33 witnesses testified on behalf of Manjul's family and 39 on behalf of Kamlesh. Finally, Manjul's family got justice. Now read how two close friends became sworn enemies Kamlesh Pathak and Manjul Chaubey, residents of Bhararipur village in Auraiya, were very good friends earlier. People used to call Manjul even the shadow of Kamlesh Pathak. When Manjul Chaubey was elected student union president from Tilak Mahavidyalaya in Auraiya, Kamlesh Pathak stood by him as his biggest supporter. A crack appeared in this friendship during the 2006 municipal elections. Manjul Chaubey wanted to contest the election, but he did not get the support of Kamlesh Pathak. This is where the distance between the two began to grow. Later, Manjul Chaubey came close to BJP leaders, while Kamlesh was an SP supporter. Meanwhile, Kamlesh Pathak started claiming a one-bigha piece of land located near the Panchmukhi Hanuman temple in the village. Manjul openly opposed this. This is where their old friendship gradually turned into a battle for dominance. Know about Kamlesh Pathak

stories.title: Mankind Hospital in Lucknow barred from operating after patient’s death:Probe team scrutinises records
stories.summary: The Health Department appears to be in action mode in the case of a woman's death that occurred two days ago at Mankind Hospital located in Gudamba, Lucknow. The department has suspended the hospital's operations until the investigation is complete. Under this, admission of new patients and treatment-related activities will also remain suspended. A Health Department team led by Dr. AP Singh, the nodal officer for private hospitals, reached the hospital on Wednesday. The team examined the documents available at the hospital and records related to the woman's treatment and recorded statements from the operator. The team has also collected necessary documents related to the hospital's operations, registration, and treatment. Team conducted an investigation by visiting the site Dr. AP Singh stated that the circumstances under which the woman died are being investigated. The team will cross-verify the hospital's documents and treatment-related records. The investigation will also examine whether there was negligence at any level during the treatment. Health department officials say that only after the investigation is complete will the cause of death and the situation regarding negligence in treatment become clear. Further action against the hospital will be decided based on the facts that emerge from the investigation.

stories.title: Former SP MLC among 10 convicted of murder:Accused had publicly killed a lawyer and her government teacher sister in Auraiya
stories.summary: A former Samajwadi Party MLC and nine others have been convicted in the 2020 murder of lawyer Manjul Chaubey and his government schoolteacher sister Sudha in Auraiya. The MP-MLA court is expected to announce their sentences shortly, with security tightened around the court. The siblings were shot dead in broad daylight on 15 January 2020. The case has seen more than 900 hearings over six years, with 72 witnesses examined by both sides. Friendship turned into rivalry Kamlesh Pathak and Manjul Chaubey were once close friends. Manjul was considered Pathak's close aide and even his bodyguard by some locals. Their relationship deteriorated during the 2006 municipal elections when Chaubey wanted to contest but did not receive Pathak's support. Their political differences deepened as Chaubey grew closer to BJP leaders, while Pathak remained associated with the Samajwadi Party. Dispute over land The murder case centred on a one-bigha plot near the Panchmukhi Hanuman Temple, located less than 500 metres from the homes of the two men. Locals said the two had once held gatherings on the land together. As their relationship soured, however, a dispute over control of the property intensified. Brother and sister shot dead On 15 January 2020, Pathak was reportedly sitting on a chair on the disputed land when Manjul's father confronted him and knocked him off the chair. Family members from both sides arrived as the argument escalated. Pathak's brother Santosh and his gunman also reached the spot. During the confrontation, shots were fired, hitting Manjul and his sister Sudha. Both died at the scene. Police later filed a chargesheet naming 11 accused. Ten were booked under the Gangsters Act in July 2020, while one accused, who was a minor, was sent to the juvenile court. Gunman Avnish Pratap Singh was acquitted under the Gangsters Act, although the murder case against him remains pending. Properties worth over ₹53 crore seized Following the double murder, authorities seized properties worth ₹36.15 crore belonging to Kamlesh Pathak, ₹9.75 crore belonging to Santosh Pathak and ₹7.51 crore belonging to Ramu Pathak. The accused in the double murder case included former MLC Kamlesh Pathak, former block chief Santosh Pathak, Ramu Pathak, Kuldeep Awasthi, Vikalp Awasthi, Rajesh Shukla, Shivam Awasthi, Ashish Dubey, Ravindra Chaubey alias Lalla, gunman Avnish Pratap Singh and Lavkush Savita. Pathak's political career Kamlesh Pathak, a resident of Bhadaripur village in Auraiya, became one of the youngest SP legislators. He was elected to the Legislative Council in 1990 and became a minister of state with an independent charge in 1991. He later returned to electoral politics and won the Derapur Assembly seat in 2002. He also contested from Dibiyapur in 2007 and Sikandra in 2012 but lost both elections. In 2013, the Samajwadi Party government appointed him chairman of the Silk Department with the rank of minister of state. He was later elected an MLC in 2015. Accused of opposing Mulayam Singh Pathak also became prominent during the movement for restoring Auraiya's district status. When the then Chief Minister Mulayam Singh Yadav abolished the district, Pathak opposed his own party's decision. According to reports, when Mulayam Singh visited Auraiya to address a rally, shots were allegedly fired at his helicopter, preventing it from landing for around an hour.

stories.title: IPS says, ‘Towel stuffed in mother’s mouth, jewellery missing’:‘Shameful to hear people say it wasn’t murder’; SP said no injuries found
stories.summary: IPS officer Ashutosh Mishra has questioned reports claiming that his 95-year-old mother, Indravati, was not murdered, saying jewellery was missing from her body and a towel had allegedly been stuffed into her mouth. Indravati died on August 16 in Ruda Dhamrua village in Ambedkar Nagar. Mishra, who is posted as SP (Headquarters) at the Police Headquarters in Lucknow, had filed a complaint against unidentified persons, alleging murder and robbery after seeing his mother’s condition. Mishra said, “Reports are saying that my mother’s jewellery has been recovered and that this is not a murder case. But how can the cause of death be established before the viscera report comes?” He said his uncle and cousins had told him that a towel had been stuffed into his mother’s mouth and that blood was coming from it. He also claimed that a ring and bangle from her right hand, along with her nose pin, earrings, necklace and anklets, were missing. “Based on these circumstances, we submitted a complaint to the police. Let me make it clear that none of the jewellery has been recovered so far. It is not right to reach any conclusion before the investigation is complete,” Mishra said. He added that he was “ashamed” that rumours were being spread about the death of an IPS officer’s mother and said the administration should have clarified the situation. SP had said no injury marks were found Ambedkar Nagar SP Prachi Singh had earlier said that no injury marks were found on Indravati’s body during the post-mortem. She said the viscera had been preserved to establish the exact cause of death. Following this, reports began suggesting that Indravati may have died of a heart attack and that there was no murder angle. The incident took place in Ruda Dhamrua village, around 30 km from the district headquarters. IPS seeks special team to investigate case Mishra said the local police administration should have denied the rumours and misinformation circulating about the case. He appealed to people not to believe or circulate information without verifying it. Mishra also said he had spoken to senior police officers, including the ADG and DIG, and requested that a special team be formed to investigate the case. “I have faith in the senior police officers. The investigation should be impartial and no innocent person should be implicated,” he said. He added that he had no objection if it took one or two months to identify the guilty person, as long as the truth emerged. Mishra also criticised reports claiming that the missing jewellery had been recovered. “People should check their sources before publishing such reports. If there is even a little truth in these rumours, I would have written to the police station asking them to close the case,” he said. Indravati was living alone after husband’s death Ashutosh Mishra was the only son of Indravati and Ram Kumar Mishra, a former principal of a government inter college. He has two sisters, both of whom are married. His father died around one-and-a-half years ago, after which Indravati was living alone at the family home. Mishra had hired a domestic worker, Pyari, to look after her. He also visited his mother with his family from time to time. On Sunday morning at around 9 am, Pyari arrived at the house to clean it and found Indravati lying on a wooden cot. She initially thought she was asleep. When Indravati did not respond to her calls, Pyari went closer and found her dead. She then informed Mishra’s uncle, Ramesh Chandra Mishra, alias Kallu, who lived nearby. Kallu reached the house and later called Ashutosh at around 9.49 am, telling him that his sister-in-law had apparently died of a heart attack and asking him to come home. Mishra’s arrival changed the course of the case Kallu informed the Malipur police at around 1 pm and requested that two constables be sent to the spot. Mishra reached the village at around 2.30 pm. After speaking to Pyari and his uncle and asking about his mother’s condition, he learnt that several pieces of jewellery were missing. These included a gold chain, a tulsi necklace, a nose pin, earrings and anklets. Based on the circumstances, the family suspected that Indravati had been murdered and her jewellery stolen. DIG Somen Verma of the Ayodhya Range and SP Prachi Singh reached the spot along with a police team from Malipur police station and inspected the scene. Police found no injury marks on Indravati’s body, although there was blood on her lips. Family members said she suffered from high blood pressure. SP says reports of jewellery recovery are misleading SP Prachi Singh said a three-doctor panel conducted the post-mortem, which was videographed. She said the post-mortem could not establish the cause of death, following which the viscera was sent to the Forensic Science Laboratory for examination. According to the SP, Kallu had initially told police that Indravati had suffered a cardiac arrest. Therefore, her heart was also sent for histopathological analysis. Singh said the items listed in the FIR had not been recovered. She clarified that some yellow metal, nail-like objects and a tulsi necklace found at the scene had been handed over to the family, but reports claiming that all the missing items had been recovered were “false and misleading”.

stories.title: Gen Alpha protest in Unnao, 250 students take to streets:Tell cops about poor hostel food; demand education minister be called before they leave
stories.summary: More than 250 students from Classes 6 to 12 staged a protest in Uttar Pradesh's Unnao on Wednesday morning, raising concerns over poor-quality hostel food, a shortage of teachers and inadequate facilities. The students, from the Jaiprakash Narayan Sarvodaya Residential School, blocked the road while holding placards reading ‘Fulfil our demands’ and ‘We need teachers’. The protest led to long queues of vehicles on both sides of the road. Police reached the spot and tried to persuade the students to clear the road, but they refused to move. The students alleged that the school had been facing a teacher shortage for six months and that poor-quality food was being served in the hostel. They also claimed that the principal threatened to issue them transfer certificates and send them home if they complained. “Call Secondary Education Minister Gulab Devi. Only then will we leave,” the students told the police. 3 pictures of student performance CDO assures students of action As the situation escalated, Chief Development Officer Kriti Raj reached the spot and assured the students that their complaints would be addressed. A special team was also formed to investigate their allegations. The students ended the protest after receiving the assurance. The demonstration began at around 6 am and continued for nearly three hours. Students allege poor hostel facilities Student Sunil said the canteen and hostel facilities were in poor condition. He alleged that hygiene was not maintained in the mess and claimed that kitchen staff consumed gutkha and other tobacco products while preparing food. He also alleged that students were served aubergine curry frequently. Another student, Abhinav, said the shortage of teachers was affecting their studies, particularly with board examinations approaching. “We need to complete our studies. If children do not receive proper education and their future remains uncertain, it will weaken the country,” he said. Students also complained about inadequate drinking water facilities. They alleged that some students had fallen ill after drinking contaminated water and did not receive timely treatment. They also said several hostel fans were not working despite the extreme heat and claimed repeated complaints had gone unanswered. 350 students study at residential school The Jaiprakash Narayan Sarvodaya Residential School is located in Nayotni Nagar Panchayat. Around 350 students study there, from Classes 6 to 12, and all of them live in the hostel. Admission to the school is through an entrance examination.

stories.title: Mary Kom’s coach to receive Dronacharya Award:Varanasi boxer Chhotelal Yadav won 2005 Asian Games gold
stories.summary: International boxer and coach Chhotelal Yadav from Pahari village in Varanasi has been selected for the prestigious Dronacharya Award. The announcement has sparked celebrations in Varanasi and the sporting community. Yadav began boxing at the age of 12 and won a gold medal for India at the 2005 Asian Games. He currently serves as a havildar in the Indian Army. After winning medals as a boxer, Yadav went on to achieve success as a coach. He began training Olympic medallist Mary Kom in 2015. Since 2022, he has also been coaching Commonwealth Games gold medallists Jasmine, Sakshi and Arundhati. Started boxing at 12 Yadav, who hails from Pahari village in the Kandwa area, took up boxing when he was just 12. In 1999, the Sports Authority of India (SAI) selected 200 athletes for training, with Yadav among those chosen. He continued training and established himself at national and international levels. His biggest achievement as a boxer came at the 2005 Asian Games, where he won gold for India. Following the achievement, he joined the Army as a havildar. Became Mary Kom's personal coach in 2015 Yadav joined Olympic Gold Quest (OGQ) in 2015 as Mary Kom's personal coach. After receiving permission from the Army, he began working with the six-time world champion. During their association, Mary Kom won several major medals, including six gold and two bronze medals. Her Olympic bronze is also among these achievements. Training the next generation of boxers Yadav has also been working with India's emerging boxing talent. Since 2022, he has coached Jasmine, Sakshi and Arundhati. The three boxers recently won gold medals at the Commonwealth Games. His training and guidance are considered an important part of their success. After winning gold for India in the ring himself, Chhotelal Yadav has now earned recognition for helping produce champions as a coach. His selection for the Dronacharya Award has brought pride and excitement to Varanasi's sporting community.

stories.title: VIDEO | 50-foot-high swing trolley breaks in Lucknow:Girls scream, ‘Stop, we’re hurt, bleeding’; 5, including siblings, injured
stories.summary: During the Sawan Mahotsav in Lucknow's upscale Indira Nagar area on Tuesday night, the trolley of a 50-foot-high amusement ride broke off while the ride was in motion. The trolley fell and collided with five or six other trolleys, injuring five children, including a brother and sister. One girl suffered bleeding from her mouth. The injured were taken to a nearby hospital, where three are reportedly in serious condition. A terrifying video of the accident has also surfaced. In the video, a girl can be seen sitting with her siblings when the ride suddenly jolts violently. Screams can be heard as she shouts, "Stop the ride, I'm hurt! I'm bleeding!" People in other trolleys also begin screaming. The ride was eventually stopped after around 10 minutes, and the injured passengers were brought down. The accident occurred at around 7.30pm near Sushma Hospital in Ismailganj, Indira Nagar. After the accident, people caught the fair operator, but he later managed to escape. Families of the injured alleged that the fair was being operated without the necessary permission and that adequate safety arrangements were not in place. Empty trolley breaks off and hits moving ride Surya Singh, a resident of Nayagaon Vijayipur in Vibhutikhand, had visited the fair with his sisters and friends. He said his sisters Ankita, 14, and Nancy, 12, were with him. Their friends Ayush Sharma, his sister Ishika and Anamika had also accompanied them. After spending around 15 minutes at the fair, they bought tickets and boarded the ride. Suddenly, an empty trolley broke off and collided with their trolley. Ankita suffered serious facial injuries, with blood coming from her nose and mouth. Nancy and Surya also sustained injuries. Before they could understand what had happened, their trolley became stuck in the middle of the ride after colliding with other trolleys below. A girl sitting in one of the lower trolleys fainted, while another girl sitting beside her was also injured. The passengers repeatedly shouted for the ride to be stopped, but Surya alleged that the operator did not respond. Amid the chaos, police personnel present nearby took the injured to Sushma Hospital near the fairground. Ankita, Nancy and two other girls are receiving treatment, while Surya was discharged after receiving first aid. 16-year-old suffers multiple fractures Arpit Singhal, CEO of Sushma Hospital, said Nisha Kumari, 16, suffered multiple fractures. Another injured girl sustained minor injuries and was discharged after receiving primary treatment. Injured blame delay in stopping ride Ankita's mother, Pushpa Singh, demanded an investigation into the fair organisers and its safety arrangements. She said, "It should be established whether the necessary permissions for the fair had been obtained. We will approach the police and file a complaint." Nancy, who was injured in the incident, alleged that the ride was not stopped immediately even after the accident. She said the delay resulted in more people being injured and that timely action could have prevented the injuries from becoming so serious. All rides at fair shut down Following the accident, all amusement rides at the Indira Nagar Sawan Mahotsav were shut down. Police said legal action would be taken after receiving a written complaint from the injured children's families.

stories.title: Olympian Priyanka Goswami to receive Arjuna Award:Race walker shines from Olympics to Asian Games
stories.summary: An athlete from the North Eastern Railway (NER) Division, Priyanka Goswami, has been selected for the prestigious Arjuna Award. Her achievement has sparked celebrations across NER and Gorakhpur. Priyanka has excelled in race walking and represented India at major international events, including the Olympics and Asian Games. She has brought recognition to both the country and Indian Railways through strong performances at several major national and international competitions. Benefiting from modern training and facilities The North Eastern Railway Sports Association provides athletes with modern sports facilities and improved training opportunities. These initiatives have helped NER players consistently perform well at national and international competitions. Priyanka is among the athletes to have benefited from these facilities. Through sustained hard work and strong performances, she has brought recognition to both India and Indian Railways. Strong performances at Olympics and Asian Games Priyanka has competed at major international sporting events, including the Olympics, Commonwealth Games and Asian Games, where she has delivered notable performances. Her consistent record at the international level has now earned her selection for one of India's most prestigious sporting honours, the Arjuna Award. Priyanka serves as officer on special duty in Izzatnagar Division Priyanka Goswami is currently working as an Officer on Special Duty (OSD) in the Izzatnagar Division of North Eastern Railway. Alongside her railway responsibilities, she continues to compete in athletics and represent India at the highest level. Following her selection for the Arjuna Award, officials of North Eastern Railway and office-bearers of the Sports Association congratulated her on the achievement. An Inspiration for NER athletes Priyanka's selection for the Arjuna Award is being seen as an inspiration for other North Eastern Railway athletes. Her success demonstrates that access to quality training and facilities, combined with sustained hard work, can help railway athletes achieve major milestones at both national and international levels.

stories.title: Rain continues in Prayagraj for 3 days, homes flooded:Cremations held on Varanasi ghat steps; alert in 68 districts, schools closed in 8
stories.summary: Monsoon rainfall continues across Uttar Pradesh, with Prayagraj receiving intermittent heavy showers for the past three days. Drizzle continued in the city on Wednesday morning, while Lucknow also received light rain. Cloudy conditions prevailed in more than 40 cities, including Agra, Varanasi and Kanpur. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for 68 districts today. Schools up to Class 12 have been closed in Prayagraj, Gonda, Kaushambi, Ghazipur and Bhadohi, while schools up to Class 8 remain closed in Jaunpur, Sonbhadra and Mirzapur. Heavy rain causes waterlogging in Prayagraj Prayagraj has been badly affected by the heavy rainfall. Water entered homes, submerging sofas, beds and other belongings. Three railway tracks at Rambagh Railway Station were also flooded. A three-storey house collapsed, while waterlogging caused several judges and lawyers to reach the High Court late. Taking note of the situation, the court summoned District Magistrate Manish Verma and Municipal Commissioner Seelam Sai Teja. More than 10 rivers in spate More than 10 rivers across the state are currently in spate. In Varanasi, floodwater from the Ganga has entered more than 100 temples located along the ghats. Water has reached the cremation areas at Manikarnika and Harishchandra Ghats, forcing cremations to be conducted on higher sections of the ghats. Namo Ghat has also been submerged, while the Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat is being conducted from the rooftop. Ganga and Yamuna flood homes in Prayagraj In Prayagraj, rising levels of the Ganga and Yamuna have started entering residential areas. A car parked near Bakshi Dam in Daraganj was submerged in the Ganga. Floodwater has also inundated low-lying areas along the Ganga in Kanpur and Unnao. Why is the monsoon active again? According to Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh, the monsoon has become active due to the formation of a low-pressure area, the northward shift of the monsoon trough and moisture flowing in from the Bay of Bengal. He said- Monsoon activity is expected to remain strong until August 23. The low-pressure system developing over the Bay of Bengal will continue to influence rainfall across the state. Heavy rain is likely on August 20 and 21.

stories.title: Woman SI created 4 channels to become famous:After suspension, followers say, ‘Madam, go live, we need to scan the QR code’
stories.summary: Meerut sub-inspector Anu, who was recently suspended, allegedly ran multiple social media accounts in an attempt to gain popularity. After arresting Muskan, the accused in the 2025 Saurabh murder case involving a blue drum, Anu reportedly created two Instagram and two YouTube channels. Around three months ago, she also started a YouTube channel under the name Selina. Her accounts contained several livestreams and videos from gyms and swimming pools. One profile featured her in uniform and carried 'UPCop' in the bio. Some livestreams also displayed a QR code for donations. After her suspension, followers began commenting on her accounts. One wrote, "She's gone now," while another said, “Madam, go live, I need to scan the QR code.” First, see pictures related to the female sub-inspector Frequently went live on social media Most of Anu's posts were livestreams. She used a photograph of herself in uniform as her profile picture and described herself as a 'UPCop' in her bio. One account also featured a photograph of ammunition. She regularly went live from her room in Meerut and interacted with followers. Anu reportedly lived alone in the city. Colleagues call her disciplined on duty Anu's phone has reportedly been switched off since her suspension and she has not been speaking to anyone. Police personnel who worked with her at Brahmapuri police station and the SSP's office said they had never seen her misbehave with anyone while on duty. They described her as disciplined and said she carried out her responsibilities properly. They added that officers' personal lives after duty hours were their own and colleagues generally did not interfere in them. YouTuber complained about her social media posts A YouTuber had raised concerns about Anu's objectionable social media posts and released a video asking Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and senior police officials to take action. In the video, he alleged that Anu's Instagram and YouTube accounts contained objectionable content and that some videos displayed a QR code for donations. He also questioned whether such activity was appropriate for a police officer and said it could affect the dignity of the Uttar Pradesh Police uniform. The YouTuber urged the authorities to issue clear rules restricting senior government officials and police personnel from posting such content on social media. Anu used the name 'Ani Colliss' on Instagram Anu, originally from Prayagraj, is a 2023-batch sub-inspector. She reportedly operated an Instagram account under the name Ani Colliss, which had 684 posts and around 1,016 followers. stories.title: ED raids Azam Khan’s Jauhar University:Team reaches 10 locations from Saharanpur to Delhi
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) raided the Jauhar University in Uttar Pradesh's Rampur, associated with jailed Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, on Wednesday morning. A team of 15 officers in six vehicles reached the university at around 7am and began examining documents. More than 100 police personnel were deployed outside the campus. Classes, however, continued on the university premises. Simultaneous searches are being conducted at 10 locations across Rampur, Saharanpur and Delhi linked to Azam Khan and the trust associated with Jauhar University. The premises include the office and residence of Saharanpur-based chartered accountant Deepak Gupta. According to sources, the ED action is being carried out under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). ED examining alleged flow of government contract funds According to investigating agencies, money allegedly received through government contracts was routed to Jauhar University and its associated trust. The allegation is that these funds were subsequently used to develop university properties and for other purposes. The ED is now investigating how the alleged government contract funds reached the trust or university and which individuals and companies were involved in the transactions. University has been under scrutiny Jauhar University has been in the spotlight in recent weeks. On July 15, the Rampur district administration ordered the demolition of 38 of the university's 40 buildings, alleging that they had been constructed without approved building plans. However, Moradabad Divisional Commissioner Anjaneya Singh's court stayed the district magistrate's order. The matter is currently pending before the court. Previous raids linked to Azam Khan July 2019: The ED conducted a search at Jauhar University and seized documents. September 2023: The Income Tax Department and ED conducted searches at Azam Khan's residence and premises linked to Jauhar University for three days. The ED subsequently issued summons after finding details of suspected bank transactions.

stories.summary: My son-in-law had threatened to put the entire family in coffins. He arrived on a motorcycle wearing a bulletproof jacket and opened fire. My son stepped in front of him and was shot dead. These are the words of Gaya Prasad, whose 48-year-old son Devendra Yadav was allegedly shot dead by his brother-in-law in broad daylight in Pratapgarh on Tuesday. The accused, Kapil Yadav, is a retired Army personnel. Police said he fired around 10 rounds in a busy market before trying to flee. Locals caught him, tied him up and assaulted him. Police rescued him from the crowd and took him to hospital. Kapil told doctors that he had opened fire in self-defence because his wife and children were not being allowed to return with him. Read the report… Shooting in busy market The incident took place at Madafarpur market, around 25km from the district headquarters. Devendra was sitting at his medical shop at around noon when Kapil arrived on a motorcycle wearing an Army uniform. An argument broke out between the two men. Witnesses said Kapil then fired around 10 rounds from a pistol. Three bullets hit Devendra — one in the head, one in the waist and one in the leg. He died during treatment at the district hospital. Police said Kapil was wearing a bulletproof jacket over his uniform. After the shooting, he tried to escape but was caught by locals. Dispute over wife and children Devendra's family said his sister Priyanka, 40, was Kapil's wife. The couple had been married for 18 years and had a 12-year-old son and an eight-year-old daughter. Kapil had served in an Army engineering unit and retired about a year ago. He later took up a security guard's job at Sultanpur district hospital and lived with his wife and children in Amethi. According to the family, Kapil had been pressuring Priyanka to bring money from her parents after building a house three months ago. On August 17, after another dispute, Priyanka called Devendra. He went to Amethi and brought his sister and her two children back to Pratapgarh. The family said Kapil abused Devendra and threatened to kill him. They also claimed that he sent threatening calls and messages. Father says police were informed Gaya Prasad claimed the family had complained to police about the threats. He said Kapil had threatened Devendra three months earlier as well, following a dispute with Priyanka. The family had approached the police outpost, after which the two sides reached a compromise. The father also alleged that Kapil consumed drugs and frequently harassed Priyanka. He claimed Kapil had substantial debt and repeatedly demanded money from her parents. 'We called police before the shooting' Gaya Prasad said Kapil called the family again on Tuesday morning and abused Devendra and other family members. "I went to the police outpost twice. It is just 50 metres from our house, but there was no police officer there. I then called the sub-inspector, but he disconnected the call," he alleged. The family later called the emergency helpline. "We were told that police would arrive within two minutes. But Kapil reached before them and started firing," Gaya Prasad said. He said Devendra came out of the shop carrying a stick. When Kapil started firing, he tried to hit the pistol with his own stick. "Devendra moved forward first. Kapil fired repeatedly and killed my son in front of me," he said. While recounting the incident, Gaya Prasad became unconscious and had to be revived by relatives. Accused claims he acted in self-defence Kapil is undergoing treatment under police custody at the district hospital. He claimed that family members attacked him with an iron rod before he opened fire. "I was hit with a rod first. When I fell, I took out my pistol," he said. Kapil also claimed that he had gone to bring his wife and children back because their education was being affected. He said he had worn a bulletproof jacket and helmet because he feared for his safety. Police register case City Circle Officer Ashutosh Mishra said Devendra was shot by his brother-in-law and died during treatment at the district hospital. "The accused is undergoing treatment at the district hospital under police custody. A case has been registered on the complaint of the victim's brother," he said.

stories.title: 6,000 families forced to live on rooftops in Prayagraj:Homes flooded, stoves unlit for 3 days; surviving on puffed rice and chickpeas
stories.summary: Rain that began at around 1 am on Sunday continued until Tuesday evening in Prayagraj. The city recorded 120mm of rain on Tuesday, taking the three-day total to 209mm. The incessant rain has flooded around 6,000 houses across the city, including nearly 2,000 in Kareli. Several areas, including JK Nagar, Gaddha Colony, Solah Market, B Block, Shams Nagar, Gaus Nagar, Jafri Colony and Barah Market, have remained waterlogged for three days. Many residents have been forced to sleep on rooftops at night, while several families have moved to relatives’ homes. Residents of multi-storey buildings have shifted to upper floors, but families living in single-storey houses have no option but to stay on their rooftops. Water has also entered Rambagh railway station, forcing authorities to suspend train movement on three tracks. The Georgetown police station has also been flooded. ‘There is no place left to cook’ The situation is particularly difficult in Mundera, where around 500 houses have been flooded. Meena Jaiswal, a resident of Mundera, said there is no space left to cook inside her home. “We have to order puffed rice and chickpeas to eat. Every morning, we remove the water from the house, but it fills up again after some time. We have to sleep on the rooftop. Our bedding and clothes have been damaged, and everything is soaked.” See 3 pictures Families forced to move belongings to rooftops The heavy rain has destroyed household belongings in several parts of the city. After the downpour began late on Sunday night, residents woke up to find water entering their homes. In a rush, they moved essential belongings to safer places. Items that could be carried to the rooftops were moved upstairs. Even on Tuesday, the third day of the rain, several families were still living on their rooftops. Residents said they were struggling with damaged belongings, poor arrangements and a lack of relief. 500 homes flooded in Mundera The densely populated Mundera area is among the worst affected. Around 500 houses have been flooded and household belongings have been damaged. Harnam Singh, a Mundera resident who spent around ₹2 crore building his house, now has water inside its lower portion. Around two feet of water has entered all the rooms, including the kitchen, toilets, bedrooms and veranda. The situation is so bad that the family has not been able to cook for the past two days. The entire family has been forced to stay on the rooftop. Their beds, sofa and storage boxes have been soaked. They are trying to protect some belongings by placing beds and large boxes on metal containers. ‘No cooking, no proper sleep for two days’ The house of retired COD Chheoki employee JB Singh and his wife Neelam Singh has also been flooded. Water has entered their kitchen, toilet and bedroom, with no outlet available for drainage. Their daily routine and meals have been severely disrupted. Meena Jaiswal’s family is facing a similar situation. Around two feet of water has remained inside their house for the past two days. The family cannot sleep properly or cook food and has been forced to stay on the rooftop. Residents fear snakes and other poisonous creatures Kanha Yadav said residents were living in extremely difficult conditions amid the floodwater. “We are living in misery surrounded by water. With water inside our homes, there is always a danger from snakes and other poisonous creatures.” Residents of Mundera have urged the administration to arrange immediate drainage and remove the accumulated water. Five houses collapse in Gohri-Mohanganj The situation is also severe in Gohri and Mohanganj, where large parts of the village have been submerged. Five houses collapsed because of the rain. One of them belonged to Yashwant Singh, who became emotional after watching his house collapse. Yashwant said the walls weakened after two days of continuous rain and eventually collapsed. “We had to move the family to another house in the middle of the night. Now we are even struggling to arrange food and drinking water.” Posh Malviya Nagar also badly affected Around 100 houses in Malviya Nagar have been flooded. Dr Manoj, a resident, said water had earlier remained confined to the roads, forcing children to walk through it to reach school. It has now started entering homes. “We pay house tax, yet this is the situation. It is called a posh colony, but the conditions are extremely poor. Garbage is lying everywhere and there is no cleaning for months.” Roads, railway tracks and public buildings under water Two days of heavy rain have flooded roads, police stations, the municipal corporation premises, hospital entrances and roads beneath railway underpasses across Prayagraj. Water has also accumulated on the railway tracks at Rambagh station. A large population in the old city was already struggling with waterlogging, while knee-deep water has now affected several posh areas as well. Allahabad High Court summons officials The waterlogging following the heavy rain has also reached the Allahabad High Court. A division bench of Justice Ajit Kumar and Justice Garima Prasad took suo motu cognisance of the situation on Tuesday. The court summoned District Magistrate Manish Verma and Municipal Commissioner Seelam Sai Teja. Waterlogging across the city also affected court proceedings. Judges and lawyers faced difficulties reaching the court, delaying the start of hearings. The court subsequently took cognisance of the widespread waterlogging in the city.

stories.title: ‘Akhilesh will never become UP CM’:Keshav says MLAs may lose tickets, but state BJP won’t decide
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya has spoken openly about preparations for the 2027 Assembly elections, organisational changes and speculation over several sitting MLAs losing their tickets. On Shivpal Yadav’s claim that Azam Khan would be made Home Minister if the Samajwadi Party returned to power, Maurya said Akhilesh Yadav would neither become the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister nor Rahul Gandhi the Prime Minister. He also questioned the SP’s PDA strategy, saying Akhilesh had led a majority government between 2012 and 2017 but had done little for backward classes and Dalits. Read Keshav Prasad Maurya's full interview Q: The BJP’s new national team has been announced. How do you view it? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Five states will go to the polls in 2027, followed by the Lok Sabha elections in 2029. This team will help the BJP win these elections by a very large margin. National president Nitin Nabin has given Uttar Pradesh adequate representation. The team is very strong and capable. Its members have helped the party win elections in other states, and this team will create a new record in Uttar Pradesh. Q: Six months are left for the elections. What is the BJP’s preparation? Keshav Prasad Maurya: If the Election Commission announces that the elections will be held in two, four or six months, we will fight strongly. The BJP is always ready for elections. We have already started preparing for the 2027 polls. The conference of booth presidents has been held and teams have been formed right up to the panna pramukh level. Q: Has the BJP’s internal survey recommended dropping the tickets of several MLAs? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Look, surveys are conducted continuously. Our original survey will not be made public. It shows that we are going to repeat our 2017 performance. In every election, tickets of many sitting MLAs are cut among the 403 seats, and new people are given opportunities. But who will lose their ticket and who will get an opportunity? That is not decided by Keshav Prasad Maurya or the Uttar Pradesh BJP. Q: Shivpal Yadav said in Rampur that Azam Khan would be made Home Minister under an SP government. What do you say? Keshav Prasad Maurya: First, the SP and Congress should understand that they are not going to return to power until 2047. Akhilesh Yadav is not going to become the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. Rahul Gandhi is not going to become the Prime Minister of the country. The SP is not going to form the government in Uttar Pradesh again. There is no substance in Shivpal’s claim. Q: The SP is making Gen Z and the alleged theft of Ram temple offerings major issues. Could this hurt the BJP? Keshav Prasad Maurya: The SP and Congress are anti-Gen Z parties. Young people have always supported the BJP. They know that opportunities are being created for them in the government and private sectors because of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Our children are competing with young people from major countries around the world. The government has made a provision of ₹1 lakh crore. Our Gen Z is working hard to achieve the Prime Minister’s goal of a developed India. Q: The SP is preparing for the election around the PDA factor. How much of a challenge do you see? Keshav Prasad Maurya: The SP’s PDA is fake. Its PDA has been exposed. Every time they talk about PDA, they change its definition. I ask Akhilesh Yadav: from 2012 to 2017, the SP had a majority government in Uttar Pradesh. You yourself were the Chief Minister. When you were in power, what did you do for backward classes and Dalits? You only deprived them of their rights and ruined the state. You promoted criminals. Their PDA means “Parivar Development Agency”. Q: The SP and Congress are going to contest the Assembly elections together. How is the BJP preparing? Keshav Prasad Maurya: The SP and Congress contested the 2017 elections together. The alliance suffered a major defeat then, and its condition will be even worse in the 2027 elections. Q: Some MLAs have started saying, ‘Hare ka sahara, Keshav bhai hamara’ (Keshav is the support of the defeated). How do you deal with this? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Under the leadership of the Chief Minister, all our MLAs are like one family. Whenever someone wins an election, they become a strong pillar. These pillars work together to take the party forward. Q: The Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway has reportedly started developing problems soon after opening. Questions are being raised about it. What do you say? Keshav Prasad Maurya: This is a national project. The expressway was very important, and people in Lucknow and Kanpur are happy that it has been built. Action has also been taken by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari against those responsible for shortcomings. If a road is supposed to last 25 years but gets damaged within five years or even one year, action will be taken against whoever is responsible. Q: What will be the BJP’s biggest election issue in 2027? Keshav Prasad Maurya: The election issue will be “Sabka saath, sabka vikas” (development for all, with everyone’s support). The focus will be on the uplift of the poor and farmers, women’s empowerment and development. There has been development on a large scale, which is why the Opposition has no issues. They are desperately looking for issues. Those who did not even consider Lord Ram a deity are now worried about what offerings have been made to him. Q: A photograph of you with Brajesh Pathak went viral with the caption, ‘Kadam-kadam milaye ja’ (keep walking together). What does it mean? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Brajesh Pathak and I already walk together. Along with us, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, state president Pankaj Chaudhary, organisational general secretary Dharampal, all former state presidents and all the major BJP leaders in the state are also working together. We will walk together in the 2027 elections as well. Q: The BJP broke its own victory record in 2017, when you were the state president. Can the record be broken again in 2027? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Definitely. In 2027, we will win by an even bigger margin than in 2017. This record will be broken. Q: It is being said that the panchayat elections may be held after the Assembly elections. Is it right to delay them? Keshav Prasad Maurya: Let me make it clear that our government has made no attempt in this direction. The delay is because of the Backward Classes Commission, which determines which seats should be reserved for which category. As far as the elections are concerned, all the Opposition parties together cannot even reach half of our strength. Opposition parties sometimes take the support of caste, sometimes farmers and sometimes students. But the people of the country can see their actions. Who are the people hiding behind farmers and resorting to violence? People are waiting for the right time to puncture the cycle, twist the hand and make the BJP’s lotus bloom.

stories.title: Yogi says ‘Arigato Gozaimasu’ in Japanese:Meets delegation in Delhi, celebrates Nagasaki governor’s birthday
stories.summary: CM Yogi met with a Japanese delegation in Delhi on Tuesday. He celebrated the birthday of Japanese Governor Kotaro Nagasaki. The CM presented him with an idol of Lord Ganesha. During this, the CM also spoke in Japanese. He said- Friends, there is a very beautiful philosophy in Japan- ‘Ichiego Ichie’, meaning every moment and every meeting is unique. This evening also holds the same sentiment for us. At the end of his address, he said in Japanese, ‘ Arigato Gozaimasu’. That is, thank you very much. The 'UP-Japan Investment Meet 2026 ', which started on 18 August, will continue till 23 August. It is being organized in Delhi and Lucknow. More than 200 prominent industrialists from Japan and CEOs of several companies will participate in it. Read Yogi's 2 big points 1-'Ancient relations between India-Japan, Buddha's compassion in them' Japan is called the land of the rising sun. Uttar Pradesh is the land of the Suryavansh (Solar Dynasty). Lord Shri Ram's Ayodhya is here. Lord Buddha gave his first sermon in Sarnath, UP. Kushinagar, the land of his Mahaparinirvana, is also here. The ancient relations between India and Japan contain Buddha's compassion, life's discipline, and also the middle path. These are also the shared values of both our countries. 2-'Lord Buddha's teachings reached Japan from UP centuries ago' CM said: Lord Buddha's teachings reached Japan from the sacred land of Uttar Pradesh centuries ago. In 752 CE, Indian Acharya Bodhisena played an important role in the eye-opening ceremony of the giant Buddha statue at Todai-ji temple in Nara. This is evidence of the deep cultural and spiritual relations between India and Japan in ancient times. CM said- The centuries-old cultural, spiritual, and people-to-people relations between India and Japan have now transformed into a modern strategic partnership. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Japan's leadership have taken the relations between both countries to new heights. CM also mentioned revolutionary Rash Behari Bose. He had taken refuge in Japan, escaping British rule, and later strengthened India's independence movement from Japan. In honor of his role in relations with Japan, he was honored with the 'Order of the Rising Sun'. Know about UP-Japan Investment meet 1- Escorts Kubota to invest ₹2,025 crore, employment for over 3,800 people A major industrial hub for Japanese companies is being developed in the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) area. Escorts Kubota company will invest ₹2,025 crore in Sector-10 of YEIDA. Tractors, construction equipment and other goods will be manufactured here. This is expected to provide employment to over 3,800 people. 2- Investment of ₹1,166 crore in two projects of Minda Minda Corporation will set up two projects in Sector-10 and Sector-24 of YEIDA. These will involve a total investment of ₹1,166 crores. These projects are expected to provide employment to approximately 6,440 people. Ignition switches, steering locks, mechatronic goods, wiring harnesses, and connection systems will be manufactured here. The projects of Escorts Kubota and Minda will bring a total investment of ₹3,191 crores. These are expected to provide employment to more than 10 thousand people. 2- Japanese City to be built on 500 acres The Yogi government is working on a plan to build a Japanese City on 500 acres of land in YEIDA. Japanese companies, along with their suppliers and small ancillary industries, will also be set up here. This will enable companies to easily obtain necessary materials. Additionally, there is hope for growth in new technology, supply chain, and employment opportunities.

stories.title: Dumper runs over 4 boys on one bike:Victims were heading to birthday party; dragged for 10 metres
stories.summary: Four boys traveling on a bike were crushed to death by a dumper in Maharajganj. All were going to celebrate a birthday. The collision was so severe that the boys were thrown 10 meters away. In the accident, three died on the spot, while one died during treatment at the hospital. People present at the scene during the accident said that the dumper and bike collided head-on. The dumper driver lost balance while trying to save the bike. After that, he collided and fell into a ditch by the roadside. The incident occurred on Tuesday at 8:30 PM near Bharat Gas Agency on the Nichlaul-Maharajganj road. Read the full story According to eyewitnesses, the accident was so horrific at 8:30 PM on Tuesday that there was screaming and chaos at the scene. Three young men died on the spot in the accident, while one young man was seriously injured. The police, who arrived after being informed by local people, immediately took the injured to the Community Health Center (CHC) Nichlaul, where doctors declared him dead after examination. As soon as information about the accident was received, the police team reached the spot and inspected the scene. After the accident, a large crowd of people gathered at the spot. The police have taken possession of all four bodies and started the process of sending them for post-mortem. It is being reported that the dumper driver lost control while trying to avoid the bike, after which the dumper fell into a ditch by the roadside. Police engaged in investigating the accident The police have started investigating the vehicles involved in the accident. stories.title: Ayodhya hotel project:Lucknow HC quashes acquisition order, calls Awaas Vikas Parishad’s decision contrary to investment policy
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court's Lucknow bench has quashed the Housing Development Council's decision regarding land acquisition related to a proposed hotel project in Ayodhya. The court clarified that after a project is approved under the government's investment and tourism policy, the concerned departments should not act contrary to their own previous decisions. The bench of Justice Alok Mathur and Justice Amitabh Kumar Rai set aside the order issued by the Housing Commissioner on 29 May, 2024. The bench has directed the state government to take a decision in accordance with law within six weeks regarding the release of this land from acquisition. This case is related to 2,530 square meters of land located in Kudakeshavpur Uparhar village. The Ayodhya Development Authority had approved the map for hotel construction on this land on 17 July, 2023. However, subsequently, the Housing Development Council issued a notification for acquisition of the same land on 19 August, 2023. The court found in its hearing that the acquisition process was initiated after the hotel's plan was approved and the construction work of the project had begun. The court emphasized that government departments should honestly comply with the promises made and decisions taken under policies promoting investment.

stories.title: ‘I am BJP MLA, I’ll get you beaten and jailed':Lakhimpur MLA threatens secretary over phone, says, “You’ll be ruined if I see you”
stories.summary: I am an MLA of the ruling party; if I just look at a tree, it will wither. No matter how powerful someone is, I will have them beaten up and put in jail. The poor public has voted for me; I am not a slave of any rich person. Lakhimpur's BJP MLA Vinod Shankar Awasthi reprimanded the secretary of the cooperative society over the phone. Actually, the MLA had gone out on a tour of the constituency, when farmers stopped him. They said that the secretary is selling government urea and NPK fertilizer at overrate. Urea fertilizer worth ₹260 is being sold at 280. ₹20 extra is being charged. Hearing this, the MLA became angry. He called the officers. After this, he got the amount recovered from 25-30 farmers refunded. The incident took place at 2 pm on 17 August at the cooperative society in Kharwahiya market. Its video surfaced on Tuesday afternoon. After listening to the farmer, MLA called and summoned the officers It is reported that farmers had been complaining for a long time about fertilizer being sold at higher prices at the Khagiapura B-Packs Society. On Monday at 2 pm, the MLA reached near the society. Farmers told him that the secretary was acting arbitrarily and not listening to anyone. On the farmers' complaint, the MLA called the officers and summoned them to the spot for investigation. AD Cooperative Zulfikar, Tehsildar Dhaurahara, and police also reached the spot. During the investigation, the society's secretary, Shridhar Verma, was not found there. Secretary apologized when MLA got angry When the MLA called ADO Cooperative Rajneesh Singh, his number was off. After this, the MLA complained to District Agriculture Officer Surya Pratap Singh. Finally, he called Secretary Shridhar Verma. On the phone, the secretary informed him that he was not present at the committee. The employees are distributing fertilizer. In response, the MLA said, ‘’It is the poor people who have voted and elected me. Such exploitation of them will not be tolerated. After this, the secretary apologized to the farmers.'' The farmers told the MLA, ''The secretary has made a mistake for the first time. Therefore, please forgive him. After this, the MLA warned the secretary that action would be taken if complaints were received in the future.''

stories.title: Panchayat secretary caught with girlfriend:Wife attacked him with slippers, accused him of running a sex racket
stories.summary: A panchayat secretary was caught by his wife with a woman inside a flat in Lucknow, leading to a heated argument between the couple. The wife beat the woman and slapped her five times before hitting her husband twice on the face with her shoes. Police reached the spot after being informed about the commotion and brought the situation under control. The incident took place on 15 August, and a video of the incident has now surfaced. Alsaf Beg, who is posted as a secretary at a gram panchayat under the Mal development block, was found with the woman in a flat at Sulabh Awas on Kursi Road. After receiving information, his wife Saba reached the spot. An argument broke out between the couple, which soon escalated into a physical altercation. The incident took place in the Gudamba area. See 2 pictures... Wife says: Husband beats her every day Wife Saba told the police in her complaint that she was married to Alsaf Beg on 9 June, 2021. Alsaf is posted as a Gram Panchayat Officer. The allegation is that he used to beat her after the marriage. Due to the husband's bad behavior, after some time, his family members threw him out of the house. Since then, she has been living with her husband in a rented house. The couple has a two-and-a-half-year-old daughter. The allegation is that Alsaf does not take care of his wife and daughter. He has threatened to kill her several times. Since the marriage, he often would not return home until late at night on some pretext or another. He would leave his wife and daughter alone. Accusation of threatening by showing off government job Saba has alleged that her husband consumes alcohol and drugs. In an intoxicated state, he beats his wife and daughter. Along with this, he threatens to throw her out of the house and marry someone else by showing off his government job. Complaints were made at the police station several times against the husband, and reconciliation was also arranged between the two, but there was no improvement in his behavior. Saba has also accused her husband of having relationships with other women and being involved in illegal activities. She has also accused her husband of running a sex racket. Action for breach of peace against Panchayat Secretary According to Gudumba Inspector Anjani Kumar Mishra, on 15 August, Saba received information that her husband Alsaf was present with a woman in a flat. Upon receiving the information, she reached Block-B of Sulabh Awas located on Kursi Road. There, Alsaf was found with a woman. After this, the UP-112 team brought both parties to Gudumba police station. Saba has filed a complaint with the police, making several allegations against her husband, including harassment and assault. The dispute between husband and wife has been sent for mediation. Meanwhile, action has been taken against Secretary Alsaf Beg for breach of peace.
