Why did Lacy cancel his stream with Mark Wahlberg? Here’s what happened
stories.summary: Streamer Lacy opted out of a collaboration with actor Mark Wahlberg due to his desire for a more authentic interaction rather than a superficial promotional appearance. Upon discovering Wahlberg's previous engagements with other creators, Lacy felt disheartened. He reiterated the importance of genuine connections, ultimately deciding that the collaboration's scripted nature did not align with his vision for a natural experience.

stories.title: Deepwater Horizon damaged deep-sea corals in 2010; NOAA is now restoring them 16 years later
stories.summary: In a groundbreaking initiative, scientists are working to revive deep-sea coral ecosystems that were harmed by an oil spill. Utilizing corals grown in laboratories along with advanced tools, they have successfully deployed these corals at great depths. This project focuses on rejuvenating delicate habitats in the Gulf of Mexico, with ongoing monitoring set to evaluate both the survival rates of the corals and the overall restoration of the ecosystem.

stories.title: Harry Potter fans forced a power cable between UK and Ireland to be relocated as it would desecrate the 'grave' of Dobby
stories.summary: In a heartwarming victory for Harry Potter fans, a significant power cable, originally set to cross Dobby the elf's cherished fictional grave, was successfully rerouted. The Greenlink interconnector project, valued in the multimillions, was adjusted to preserve this beloved memorial. Developers resorted to horizontal drilling to lay the cable underground, safeguarding Dobby's resting place on Freshwater West beach from any desecration.

Michigan to remove the Sanback Dam in 2026, restoring 14 wetland acres and protecting more than 70 downstream miles
stories.summary: The historic removal of a dam in Michigan, over a century old, is set to rejuvenate the region's natural ecosystems. This collaborative project will facilitate the movement of aquatic life by clearing upstream habitats while addressing the environmental threats posed by polluted sediments. Restoration efforts will focus on enhancing wetlands and safeguarding vital cold water habitats downstream, fostering biodiversity and ecological balance.

stories.summary: Parliament's Monsoon Session concluded with twelve bills passed by both houses. Lok Sabha productivity reached nineteen percent while Rajya Sabha recorded thirty-nine percent. Opposition parties repeatedly disrupted proceedings and avoided government-offered discussions. The Public Examinations Bill was the only legislation fully discussed in Lok Sabha. Minister Kiren Rijiju expressed disappointment with the quality of parliamentary debates.

stories.title: Student Lillie Vehling rescued 3 girls drowning in Lake Washington during Blue Angels weekend
stories.summary: College student Lillie Vehling rescued three girls from Lake Washington during Seafair weekend. She noticed the girls struggling beyond the buoy line and immediately entered the water. Vehling, a former lifeguard and water polo player, brought the girls to safety one by one. First responders arrived and provided medical assistance after the successful rescue. Seafair honored Vehling as the "Lady Guardian of Lake Washington" for her bravery.

If vivid dreams leave you exhausted, experts say the problem may not be the dreams but disruptions that prevent deep sleep
stories.summary: Feeling fatigued after dreaming is often linked to disrupted sleep patterns, especially during REM phases. During REM, the brain remains highly engaged, which prevents achieving deeper rest. If dreams are recalled, it signals that you woke while dreaming, interrupting the crucial restorative stages of sleep. This interference obstructs clearing adenosine, a natural sleep-inducing byproduct, making tiredness arise from your awakening moment rather than the dreams themselves.

stories.title: Parliament Monsoon Session ends amid disruptions; Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha adjourned sine die
stories.summary: The Monsoon Session of Parliament concluded with both houses adjourned sine die. Repeated disruptions and political confrontations marked the proceedings throughout the session. The Rajya Sabha passed the Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill after skipping question hour. Opposition MPs continued protests in the Lok Sabha demanding statements from ministers. The session ended after weeks of political confrontation and frequent disruptions.

Minnesota church closes after 70 years, gives $600,000 to nonprofits and supports housing
stories.summary: St. Mark's United Church of Christ closed after seven decades due to declining membership. The congregation distributed approximately $600,000 among 21 local nonprofits. A substantial gift of $115,000 went to Loaves & Fishes for meal provision. The church property will be redeveloped into affordable housing units for the community. This act ensures the church's legacy continues through support and new homes.

More than 99% of California’s sunflower sea stars vanished, now scientists have found a mysterious colony that could help revive dying kelp forests
stories.summary: Ten years ago, sunflower sea stars faced near extinction due to a devastating marine epidemic, leading to unchecked sea urchin populations that destroyed essential kelp forests. Recently, a newly identified colony of these sea stars has rekindled hope for ecological restoration. Researchers are examining their resilience to diseases, which could greatly benefit efforts to reintroduce these vital predators to their ocean habitats.

stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the disputed Kuril Islands for the first time. This visit occurred amid deeply strained relations between Russia and Japan. Japan strongly protests the visit, reiterating its territorial claims over the islands. The long-standing dispute has intensified since Russia's invasion of Ukraine. This territorial disagreement prevents a formal World War II peace treaty.

stories.summary: Delaware proclaimed August 15, 2026, as India Day, joining New York and New Jersey. Governor Matthew Meyer highlighted the growing Indian-American community's contributions to Delaware. New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill and New York Governor Kathy Hochul also issued similar proclamations. These declarations recognize the Indian-American community's significant contributions to society. The proclamations coincide with India's upcoming 80th Independence Day celebrations.

stories.summary: NEET-PG 2026 aspirants received incorrect SMS alerts regarding their allotted examination cities. A technical glitch caused the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences to send wrong messages. The board has since issued corrected SMSes and emails to affected candidates. Aspirants are advised to verify their exam city details on the official NBEMS applicant portal. Candidates should rely only on official communications and avoid misinformation.

stories.title: Missile threat made Trump move to smaller US jet during Turkey visit: Report
stories.summary: US President Trump was secretly moved to a smaller aircraft due to a missile threat. This extraordinary security operation occurred during his return from Turkey last month. The larger presidential plane was used as a decoy while he traveled separately. Secret Service acted on credible and imminent intelligence regarding the danger. The operation remained secret to conceal the president's movements from potential attackers.

Virginia rebuilt 1.09 miles of shoreline, creating new marsh and oyster reef in Chesapeake Bay
stories.summary: Virginia’s $8 million Ragged Island restoration project rebuilt 1.09 miles of shoreline, creating 2.6 acres of marsh and 2.2 acres of oyster reef. Funded by NOAA Fisheries, the project is reducing erosion and keeping hundreds of tons of sediment and nutrients out of Chesapeake Bay while creating valuable habitat for fish, crabs and birds.

stories.title: Louisiana creates 1,170 acres of wetlands; shrimp and crabs return to restored habitat after a year
stories.summary: Louisiana’s Upper Barataria Marsh Creation Project has restored 1,170 acres of new wetland habitat in the Barataria Basin. One year after construction, white and brown shrimp, blue crab and red drum are using the restored marsh and water features. The project aims to rebuild coastal ecosystems damaged by decades of land loss and the Deepwater Horizon oil spill.

Quote by Voltaire: 'Life is a shipwreck, but we must not forget to sing in the lifeboats'
stories.summary: Life often throws insurmountable challenges our way, yet how we respond is within our control. A saying mistakenly linked to Voltaire beautifully encapsulates this spirit of resilience. This notion complements Viktor Frankl's concept of tragic optimism, proposing that we can find joy amid adversity. Embracing radical acceptance allows us to confront our circumstances, paving the way to discover meaning and happiness even in the darkest times.

Quote by Montesquieu: 'Success of most things depends upon knowing how long it will take to succeed'
stories.summary: Jeff Bezos led Amazon by prioritizing a long-term vision rather than chasing short-term gains. This perspective aligns with Montesquieu's philosophy that success is often a lengthy journey. Misjudging project timeframes can lead to distress and hasty strategy changes. Insights from modern behavioral science highlight the planning fallacy and sunk cost biases. To excel in any domain, it is crucial to accurately grasp how long true mastery takes.

A $13.5 million Maryland project turned dredged sand, silt and shell into roughly 70 acres
stories.summary: In an impressive $13.5 million initiative, 70 acres of tidal wetland habitat have been established. By reusing dredged river sediment, a previously eroding marsh area was restored, benefiting local wildlife and commercial shipping activities alike. The introduction of native salt marsh grasses has fortified this new terrain, enhancing its stability. As a result, Maryland's shoreline and diverse wildlife now enjoy enhanced protection and habitat restoration.

stories.summary: Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Wednesday met with the Governor to recommend a 10-day parole for Jagtar Singh Hawara on humanitarian grounds, citing the deteriorating health of the prisoner's mother.

Florida completed a 2,560-acre stormwater treatment landscape with 4,750 acre-feet of storage
stories.summary: A groundbreaking environmental restoration initiative in South Florida has marked a pivotal achievement with the completion of the Indian River Lagoon-South C-23/C-24 Stormwater Treatment Area. Designed to effectively capture and purify contaminated runoff before it can harm coastal ecosystems, this facility represents a crucial advancement in the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan and aims to enhance the health of essential estuaries and water quality overall.

stories.summary: David Stevenson, who was found abandoned as a two-day-old baby in a London flats corridor in 1960, has finally discovered his biological family more than six decades later. Appearing on This Morning, David opened up about his emotional search, meeting his relatives in the Netherlands and learning more about his biological mother, Petra.

stories.title: Assam floods: Toll rises to 103; 87,000 remain affected in four districts
stories.summary: Around 86,800 people are still affected by the floods in Golaghat, Jorhat, Nagaon and Sivasagar. Golaghat remains the worst-hit district, with more than 42,000 people affected. Nagaon has around 20,000 affected residents, while Sivasagar has about 15,000. The situation has nevertheless improved compared with Tuesday, when nearly 1.13 lakh people were affected across the four districts. Authorities are continuing relief operations in the affected areas.

stories.summary: Clavicular has reacted to reports about Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s split from Riley Roberts with a short message: “I can fix her.” The breakup was reportedly not recent and may have happened around two years ago. The comment comes after Ocasio-Cortez and Clavicular previously disagreed over looksmaxxing and its message to young men. She has not publicly responded to Clavicular so far.

stories.title: Florida's 23-acre Bannon Island, held by one family for roughly 150 years and reachable only by boat
stories.summary: Nestled near Haines City, Florida, Bannon Island—a coveted private island—has hit the market after remaining in one family for four generations. The residence skillfully marries aged 19th-century cypress wood with contemporary glass elements. With additional buildings and lush landscapes, the potential for creative development is endless. It offers the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility, keeping Orlando and Tampa just a short distance away.

stories.summary: The Shell Rock River Watershed initiative in Minnesota has made significant strides by securing 588 acres of critical habitat, surpassing its original objective by 105 acres through extensive restoration work. This program focused on acquiring various properties while bolstering wetlands and prairie habitats. Backed by funding for land purchases and aquatic enhancements, these projects are vital for the future of Minnesota's fish and wildlife.

stories.title: ‘Delete posts, apologise’: Bengal CM Adhikari orders action over derogatory posts about Netaji
stories.summary: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari has ordered action against those making offensive comments online. He has directed law enforcement to apprehend social media users who disparage historical icon Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. Additionally, Adhikari has mandated that MLAs establish public service centers named for Netaji, each receiving thirty thousand rupees in monthly state assistance to ensure service delivery to their constituents.

stories.title: Delhi Police’s ‘Kuchu Puchu’ Gen-Z twist to warn Delhiites about Chinese manjha
stories.summary: In a recent social media post, the police urged residents to enjoy kite flying but stay away from banned Chinese manjha and plastic-coated strings, which can cause serious injuries to people and animals. “Dear Kuchu Puchu, Patang Udao but Say NO to Chinese Manjha, Samjhe?” the police wrote, giving its usual safety messaging a more playful, social media-friendly tone.

Dogs can read human emotions! Scientists want you to smile
stories.summary: New research confirms dogs can differentiate human emotions through facial expressions. Their brains process happy faces in a unique reward region, showing emotional significance. Dogs also distinguish between fear, anger, and sadness with distinct brain activity patterns. This ability developed through domestication, aiding their social understanding of humans. Understanding these emotions does not mean dogs experience them identically to people.
